essence: Sun-sap forcibly drawn; difference thinned prayed.

sections.SUMMARY: Limited measures fail; sun-sap drawn by force; difference thinned.

rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at sun sapped, difference thinned
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: drawn hard, thinned clean. Thinning relished.
